## How to act on this report

1. Resolve every ambiguous row first; they block any confident edit.
2. Apply `update-site-data` rows to `site/src/data/primitives.ts` and `site/src/data/comparison.ts` together, then regenerate the published files.
3. Treat `extend-site-model` rows as content design work, not a data edit.
4. Re-run the comparison before opening a pull request so the report reflects the edits.
